main_text.p: QuÆ rursus Elementa, ratione motus, sunt Levia aut Gravia: eaq; magis minúsve, prout virtus illorum naturalis agit.
Leve Elementum est, cuius motus proprius rectilineus à centro Mundi est sursum: ut Ignis & Aër.
Ignis est Elementum levissimum, calidissimum & siccum.
Ignis itaq; Elementum erit supremum, cœlo Lunæ proximum & contiguum: ideoq; substantia sua tenuissimum, subtilissimum & pelluciditissimum,
unde sua tenuitate facillimè dissipatur, minimeq; alienis qualitatibus æđi potest.
Eâ quoq; sui parte, quâ Cœlo est contiguum, maximeq; distans ab aliis Elementis, purìssimum erit.
Atq; cùm Ignis sit summè calidus, primum ac proprium caloris subjectũ: ideo in alia extra se posita maximè est activus: suaq; siccitate, ob adjunctum excellentem calorem, humidum absumit ac depascit.
Aër est Elementum leve, humidissimum, calidum.
Hic Ignis elemento proximè succedit, eiq; superiore sui parte est contiguus: ubi proinde duo ista Elementa invicem communicant in qualitatibus, ac impuriora exsistunt.
Substantiæ est, tenuitate, subtilitate & pelluciditate, Igni secundæ.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "subjectũ" and "suaq; siccitate" are uncertain; "æđi" in the line "alienis qualitatibus æđi potest" is illegible in the scan and is given as printed in my best reading. The line "ciditate,Igni secundæ." ends with a catchword-like mark "secundæ." followed by "B 3", treated as the signature. The line "ut Ignis & Aër." is printed with italic words. Several words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "subtilitate", "ideoq;"); I have transcribed them as they appear. Long s is rendered as s in the transcription above; per the instructions, long s should be a plain s, so this should be corrected to s.
